young.line: Hey, little songbird, cat got your tongue?
stanza: Hey, little songbird, cat got your tongue?
Always a pity for one so pretty and young
When poverty comes to clip your wings
And knock the wind right out of your lungs
Hey, nobody sings on empty

partner.line: Always a pity for one so pretty and young

young.line: Hide your horses, hold your tongue
stanza: Hide your horses, hold your tongue
Hang the rich and spare the young
Who drain the spirits from the jars
Hop the fences, steal the cars
Run on fumes and from the law
And burn for us right through the fall

partner.line: Hang the rich and spare the young

stanza: Now your lips are on the line
Now there is a broken tongue
Met you so young
Felt so frozen

partner.line: Now there is a broken tongue
